answer: A stake-bonded registry resists Sybils like a prism splitting one beam into many costs: each identity must lock a refundable deposit that is slashed on proven fraud, so spawning a thousand sock-puppets means locking a thousand stakes. Attackers face an ocean of capital cost while honest agents pay once and earn it back through good work. No fable of free identities survives when every new face has a price tag attached.
